title: Climate Justice for Armenia and Greta Thunberg protest outside UN office against COP29/Azerbaijan
reason: Opened contemporaneous source reports the signed letter was addressed to the UN and demanded that it hold Azerbaijan accountable; no demand directed to Armenia’s government is reported. This is an international/Azerbaijan target, not an own-state policy demand under the codebook.
notes: Attendance is unreported and not independently established; exclusion is based on reported target. Related reports S004–S006 remain search_only and may be same-episode coverage.
